SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.........
Section 1, Special Branch.........Station/
REPORT
Date June 30, 1938
Subject. Communication dated 23-6-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Boris Sseroff and Mrs. Langley.
Made by D.J.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by

Boris Alexandrovich SsEROFF and his wife Olga
Pavlovna LANGLEY, Soviet citizens, ballet artists by
profession, are reported to have first appeared in the
Far East in 1927 when they arrived in Harbin from the
U.S.S.R. being engaged to perform in a local theatre.
In 1928 they visited Shanghai and during the autumn of
the same year proceeded to Manila with A. Sarpi's " Pari-
sian Review Company". They returned to Shanghai in Janu-
ary, 1929 and shortly afterwards left for Harbin. In
1932 they visited Shanghai as members of A. Sarpi's Light
Opera Company. Since that time they are reported to
have been residing mostly in Harbin and from that city
to have visited other cities and ports in the Far East.
In August, 1938 they arrived in Shanghai from Harbin and
until the close of the season were connected with the
Russian Light Opera Company.

While in Shanghai they did not come to Police
notice in connection with any activities of an undesirable
character.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

报告
日期：1938年6月30日
事由：荷兰总领事馆于1939年6月23日来函，涉及鲍里斯·谢罗夫（Boris Sseroff）及兰利夫人（Mrs. Langley）。
由 D.J.I. 普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报。转呈者

据报，苏联公民、职业芭蕾舞演员鲍里斯·亚历山德罗维奇·谢罗夫（Boris Alexandrovich SsEROFF）及其妻子奥尔加·帕夫洛夫娜·兰利（Olga Pavlovna LANGLEY），于1927年首次出现在远东地区，当时他们从苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟抵达哈尔滨，受聘在当地剧院演出。1928年，他们访问上海，并于同年秋季随 A. 萨尔皮（A. Sarpi）的“巴黎评论剧团”（Parisian Review Company）前往马尼拉。他们于1929年1月返回上海，不久后离开前往哈尔滨。1932年，他们作为 A. 萨尔皮轻歌剧团（Light Opera Company）成员再次访问上海。据报，自那时起，他们主要居住在哈尔滨，并从该城市访问了远东的其他城市和港口。1938年8月，他们从哈尔滨抵达上海，直至演出季结束，一直与俄罗斯轻歌剧团（Russian Light Opera Company）有合作关系。

在上海期间，他们未因任何不良性质的活动引起警方注意。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）
D. S. I.

副警务总监（特务科）。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1911.                                SHANGHAI,        23rd June 1939.

Sir,
    I have the honour to inform you that BORIS ALEXANDROVITCH
SEROV (Seroff), and his wife OLGA PAVLOVNA MANJELEY, have applied
to this Consulate General for a vise for admission into the
Netherlands Indies.
    Boris Serov is in possession of a Soviet passport No.012053,
issued by the Soviet Consulate at Harbin on May 21, 1937, valid
until December 12, 1937, and afterwards extended at Shanghai until
June 6, 1940.
    According to this document he is born at Odessa on December
12, 1898.
    His wife is in possession of a Soviet passport No.012054,
issued by the Soviet Consulate at Harbin on May 21,1937 valid
until October 10, 1937, and afterwards extended at Shanghai until
April 19, 1940. She is stated to have been born at Odessa on
December 30, 1903.
    Both persons have been connected with the Russian Light
Opera at Shanghai, he as a Producer and Balletmaster and she as
a Prima Ballerina.
    They intend to enter into a contract with the Cabaret Hel-
ledoorn at Sourabaia, however before they decide to sign the
contract they wish to know whether a vise for admission into the
Netherlands Indies will be granted.
    I should be obliged to you if you would let me know,if possible,
whether anything is known against these persons from a political
and moral point of view.

                                                I have the honour to be,
                                                        Sir,
                                                Your obedient servant,

To the Deputy Commissioner                        Consul-General.
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,

            SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA

编号：1911                                上海，1939年6月23日

先生：
    谨此通知阁下，鲍里斯·亚历山德罗维奇·谢罗夫（SEROV，亦作 Seroff）及其妻子奥尔加·帕夫洛夫娜·曼热莱（MANJELEY）已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。
    鲍里斯·谢罗夫持有苏联护照，号码为012053，由苏联驻哈尔滨领事馆于1937年5月21日签发，有效期至1937年12月12日，后在上海延期至1940年6月6日。
    根据该文件，他于1898年12月12日出生于敖德萨。
    其妻子持有苏联护照，号码为012054，由苏联驻哈尔滨领事馆于1937年5月21日签发，有效期至1937年10月10日，后在上海延期至1940年4月19日。据称她于1903年12月30日出生于敖德萨。
    两人均曾受雇于上海的俄罗斯轻歌剧团，他担任制作人兼芭蕾大师，她担任首席芭蕾舞女演员。
    他们打算与泗水（Sourabaia）的赫勒多恩歌舞厅（Cabaret Helledoorn）签订合同，但在决定签署合同之前，他们希望确认是否会获发进入荷属东印度的签证。
    如蒙告知，从政治和道德角度来看，是否掌握有关这些人的任何不利情况，本人将不胜感激。

                                                谨致
                                                        敬礼，
                                                您忠实的仆人，

致副警务总监                            总领事
上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科，

            上海。
